links.heading: We Turn Intelligence Into Motion. From Robots To Physical AI.
links.sub-heading: Your hand switches from a gentle grip on an egg to a firm hold on a box without a second thought. A robot needs tactile sensing, motor control and power working together to do the same. The AI model supplies the intelligence, and thousands of chips turn it into motion.
